source_supported_facts: Main graph runs 64 layers; MTP layer tensors are skipped and not executed.
Normal context filters layer index below main layer count for both SW/global caches; expected full-context F16 KV is1024MiB, but1040 retained as conservative preheader allowance.
A single vocab153600 x hidden5120 F32 expansion is3000MiB; FFN27392 x hidden5120 F32 is535MiB.
CUDA fallback conversion allocates temporary tensors through a pool. Legacy pool can retain old buffers and grows requested sizes by about5%; VMM highwater and graph/handles must be budgeted.

Native CPU chat-schema/final-content and tokenizer exactness checks, preserving any failures
Source-based plan adjustment if actual artifact differs
Fresh physical GPU3 free/margin plus unchanged own-process guard, then separately authorized startup and maximum-context resource measurement
